content: प्रमाथिन् {%a.%} .²1 Tormenting, harassing, torturing, afflicting, harrowing; क्व रुजा हृदयप्रमाथिनी क्व च ते विश्वसनीयमायुधम् <ls>M. 3. 2</ls>; <ls>Māl. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 14</ls>. .²2 Killing, destroying. .²3 Agitating, setting in motion; इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः <ls>Bg. 2. 60</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">6. 34</ls>. .²4 Tearing or pulling down, striking down; वर्त्मसु ध्वजतरुप्रमाथिनः <ls>R. 11. 58</ls>. .²5 Cutting down; प्रमाथिनस्तान् भवमार्गणानाम् (बाणान्) <ls>Ki. 17. 31</ls>. .²6 (In <ab>medic.</ab>) Producing secretion of the vessels. --{%m.%} <ab>N.</ab> of a year.
